activity.notes: Collins chaired the Irish Provisional Government from 16 January 1922 until his death on 22 August 1922. The Irish Free State was not established until 6 December 1922, after his death, so ATLAS does not back-project that later state over his chairmanship.

sources.title: Michael Collins, Chairman Provisional Government
sources.citation_text: The National Library of Ireland identifies the Chairman of the Provisional Government as a transitional post established in January 1922 and states that Collins held it from 16 January to his death on 22 August 1922.
